[[File:Cryo Infliction icon.png|right]]
[[Cryo Infliction]] is an [[Arts Infliction]] in [[Arknights: Endfield]].

== Overview ==
[[Cryo Infliction]] is a debuff applied by both Operators and Enemies lasting for {{Color|20|1d}} seconds. If Cryo Infliction is applied to a unit who already has Cryo Infliction, then the debuff's duration is reset and the Cryo Infliction gains a stack (up to a maximum of 4 stacks).

=== Friendly ===

Some [[Operators]] are capable of applying [[Cryo Infliction]].
* If an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with Cryo Infliction, then an [[Arts Burst|Cryo Burst]] is triggered dealing {{Color|160% ATK|1d}} as {{Color|Cryo DMG|4}}.
* If an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with a [[Arts Infliction|Non-Cryo Arts Infliction]], then [[Solidification]] is triggered.

=== Enemies ===
Some [[Enemies]] are capable of applying [[Cryo Infliction]].
* If the Operator recieves 4 stacks of [[Cryo Infliction]], then [[Solidification]] is triggered.

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Cryo Infliction}} can now stack up to four times.
*** [[Arts Burst|Cryo Burst]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with Arts Infliction, add one more stack of Cryo Infliction (up to 4 times) and trigger an Cryo Burst.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with Cryo Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Cryo Inflictions and trigger an Cryo Burst.
*** [[Solidification]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with a non-Cryo Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} existing stacks of Cryo Infliction to trigger [[Solidification]] with the latter determining the strength or {{G|Status Level}} of the reaction.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies a Cryo Infliction to an enemy with a non-Cryo Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger Solidification.
* <b>Beta Test I</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Cryo Infliction}} added.
*** When an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with Cryo Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Cryo Inflictions and trigger an [[Arts Burst|Cryo Burst]].
*** When an Operator applies Cryo Infliction to an enemy with a non-Cryo Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger [[Solidification]].
}}
